therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: fluorescent imaging agent for lymph node detection
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: lymphatic drainage visualization during sentinel lymph node biopsy
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with breast cancer or melanoma undergoing sentinel lymph node biopsy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: optimal dose for lymph node visualization

results.target_engagement_evidence: 100% of participants had at least 1 lymph node detected; 100% of identified tissue confirmed as lymph node by histopathology
biomarker_changes: Plasma concentration peaked at 30 minutes post-dose (1.75 ng/mL)
Detectable plasma levels from 10 minutes through end of surgery
safety_signals: No treatment emergent adverse events reported

context.indication: sentinel lymph node biopsy in breast cancer or melanoma
